podcast.title: Chess Player on the Road
podcast.body: Matthew Schultz, the frontman for Cage the Elephant, utilizes his downtime while on tour by playing chess against the band's road crew. This provides him with a recreational activity during their extensive travel schedule. "Matthew Schultz of Cage the elephant spends his downtime on the road playing chess against the road crew."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: 60 Mind-Blowing Facts About Music in 60 Minutes: 2017 Edition

podcast.title: Former Plumber
podcast.body: Matt Shultz, the singer for Cage the Elephant, previously worked in construction, specializing in plumbing. "Plumbing was his specialty."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: 60 Mind Blowing Facts in 60 Minutes: The 5th Edition
